title: Laptops which run Arch
body: I realize that Linux on Laptops and TuxMobil.org list laptops that run linux. But I am wondering what laptops the Arch community is using. So what laptops, make and model, do you have which are running Arch. My curiosity stems from the fact that I am getting a laptop once I pass my PhD qualifying exams in mathematics. So I am looking to buy.
